items.text: AMEND (T) AND RECOMMIT TO LOCAL GOVERNMENT
COMMITTEE DISCHARGED AND COMMITTED TO RULES

items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the county law, in relation to communication service
surcharges applied to Albany county; and providing for the repeal of such
provisions upon expiration thereof
items.lawCode: Add §338, County L; amd §186-g, Tax L
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S8246

SPONSOR: BRESLIN
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the county law, in relation to communication service
surcharges applied to Albany county; and providing for the repeal of
such provisions upon expiration thereof

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

Allows the County of Albany to impose an additional ninety-five cent
surcharge per access line per month to pay for costs associated with
maintaining the 911 emergency telephone system.

 
SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Section 1: Amending County Law to add a new section 337.

Section 337: County of Albany Enhanced 911 emergency system.
(1) Establishes that Albany County, acting through the local county
legislative body can amend local laws to impose a surcharge, not to
exceed ninety-five cents per access line per month to improve and main-
tain the County 911 emergency telephone system.

(2) Establishes through local law the amount of the surcharge, the date
on which the service supplier shall begin to add such surcharge to bill-
ings, and to the extent practicable, the date on which such E911 service
would begin.

(3)Any service supplier within a municipality which has imposed a
surcharge pursuant to the provisions of this section shall be given a
minimum forty-five days written notice prior to the date it shall begin
to add such surcharge to the billings.

(4) The surcharge established pursuant to the provisions of this section
shall be imposed on a per access line basis on all current bills
rendered for local exchange access service within the 911 service area.

(5): No such surcharge shall be imposed upon more than seventy-five
exchange access lines per customer per location.

(6): Lifeline customers, a public safety agency and any municipality,
which has enacted a local law pursuant to the provisions of this
section, shall be exempt from any surcharge imposed.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Albany County has requested legislation to impose a surcharge of not to
exceed ninety-five cents per access line per month to pay for the costs
associated with obtaining, operating and maintaining telecommunication
equipment and telephone services needed to provide an enhanced 911
(E911) emergency telephone system to serve such county.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:
This legislation will have no fiscal implications for the state. The
funds raised by the surcharge will be used by in the county for upgrades
to its emergency communications systems.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately and shall be deemed repealed ten
years after it shall have become a law.
